tips.soil: Alluvial soil — excellent for paddy, wheat and vegetables
tips.water: High water table in most areas; canal irrigation available
tips.market: Key mandis: Patna, Muzaffarpur, Katihar, Purnia, Darbhanga
tips.focus: Focus on paddy-wheat rotation; diversify with maize and vegetables for better income

tips.soil: Indo-Gangetic plains — highly fertile; suited for all crops
tips.water: Large canal network; ground water available
tips.market: Key mandis: Lucknow, Agra, Varanasi, Kanpur, Allahabad
tips.focus: Wheat-rice cropping system dominant; diversify into pulses for soil health

tips.soil: Sandy loam to loam soils; highly productive
tips.water: One of most irrigated states; canal + tubewell irrigation
tips.market: Key mandis: Amritsar, Ludhiana, Patiala, Bathinda
tips.focus: Diversify from paddy-wheat to reduce water use; explore maize, oilseeds

tips.soil: Black cotton soil (Regur) — excellent for cotton and soybean
tips.water: Rainfed farming dominant; irrigation limited to river command areas
tips.market: Key mandis: Pune, Nashik, Nagpur, Aurangabad, Solapur
tips.focus: Intercropping soybean with tur gives good returns; adopt micro-irrigation

tips.soil: Sandy and sandy loam soils; drought-prone
tips.water: Water scarce; drip/sprinkler irrigation essential; PMKSY benefits available
tips.market: Key mandis: Jaipur, Jodhpur, Bikaner, Kota, Ajmer
tips.focus: Mustard and cumin are high-value crops; adopt drought tolerant varieties

tips.soil: Black and red soils; medium to deep
tips.water: Narmada-based canal irrigation in some areas; rainfed in others
tips.market: Key mandis: Indore, Bhopal, Jabalpur, Gwalior, Rewa
tips.focus: Soybean-wheat rotation is dominant; gram cultivation can be expanded

tips.soil: Alluvial delta soils — highly fertile; suited for paddy
tips.water: High rainfall; flood-prone in north; irrigation needed in summer
tips.market: Key mandis: Kolkata, Siliguri, Asansol, Malda
tips.focus: Triple cropping possible; vegetables and flowers are lucrative in peri-urban areas

tips.soil: Alluvial, red and black soils; varies by region
tips.water: Major irrigation from Krishna and Godavari rivers
tips.market: Key mandis: Vijayawada, Kurnool, Tirupati, Guntur
tips.focus: Chilies and aquaculture are high-value specialities; invest in cold storage

tips.soil: Red soils; laterite and black cotton soils in different zones
tips.water: Cauvery river irrigation; semi-arid in north; good rainfall in coastal areas
